notes.title: Streaming Mode
notes.content:
Hello, this is Studio AWE.

 As it turns out, more people wanted to stream than we had expected. So, we've decided to come up with "Streaming Mode" as a way to allow you to stream, just with a couple of restrictions.

 Therefore, [h3]if you are planning to live stream or record any videos with the purpose of uploading them, you must turn "Streaming Mode" ON beforehand.[/h3]

 [h3]Streaming Mode can be toggled at the bottom of the "Options" screen accessible from the title screen.[/h3]

 Please note that you cannot change modes between "Streaming Mode" and normal mode during the course of the game, so please be careful.

 The features of the "Streaming Mode" are as follows.

[list]
[*] The "Streaming Mode" indicator text has been added in the lower-left corner of the dialogue window.
[*] You can view all of the main episodes.
[*] You cannot, however, view side episodes with the exception of "Shin Hyo Jin", "Truth".
[*] You also cannot view any of the "After Stories" and "Another Story".
[/list]
 It would be greatly appreciated if streamers and viewers were to abide and respect this new streaming policy. I would also like to take this chance to thank all the streamers who have tolerated our embargo period.

 Thank you.

notes.title: Announcement of the release and the streaming policy
notes.content:
Hello, this is Studio AWE.

 Gwan Moon High School has finally been released.

 I would like to sincerely thank you for waiting the game for a long time.



 [h3]Streaming Policy[/h3]

 Please take note that we will prohibit streaming of the full version for a certain period of time upon the game's release. And so this includes all videos ranging from but not limited to; live streaming, Let's Plays and etc. That said, [b]streaming of the demo version is and always will be permissible.[/b]

 The volume of the demo is as follows.
[list]
[*] Intro
[*] Ghost Story
[*] Fear
[*] Victim
[*] Detour
[*] Message
[*] Hideout
[/list]
 The side episode that appear after "Victim" chapter is not included in the demo version, so please be careful when you stream the demo volume after purchasing the full game.

 The reason behind this decision is to protect the rights of other users who have been waiting for a long time and those willing to purchase the game even though they lack information about the game, so I hope streamers and fans will understand and respect this verdict.

 This is not a permanently binding decision, as we'll allow you to stream freely eventually, after a certain period of time (still indeterminate), so please kindly abide by it and stay tuned.

 Thank you.

notes.title: Announcement of the release date and the streaming policy
notes.content:
Hello, this is Studio AWE.



 [h2]Release Date[/h2]

 I would like to inform you that the release date of Gwan Moon High School has finally been decided.

 It is scheduled to be released at 24:00 on March 12, 2021. (Or at 0:00 on March 13)

 It's based on KST, so that makes it [b]7:00 on March 12, 2021 on PST[/b].



 [h2]Streaming Policy[/h2]

 Please take note that we will prohibit streaming of the full version for a certain period of time upon the game's release.

 And so this includes all videos ranging from but not limited to; live streaming, Let's Plays and etc. That said, [b]streaming of the demo version is and always will be permissible[/b].

 The reason behind this decision is to protect the rights of other users who have been waiting for a long time and those willing to purchase the game even though they lack information about the game, so I hope streamers and fans will understand and respect this verdict.

 This is not a permanently binding decision, as we'll allow you to [b]stream freely eventually, after a certain period of time (still indeterminate)[/b], so please kindly abide by it and stay tuned!



 [h2]The "demo playthrough" review event[/h2]

 The "demo playthrough" review event is still currently underway. I'm looking forward to your participation.

 Please refer to the announcement below on how to join and other useful information:

 [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/380680/view/3046091653114048318]Announcement of the "demo playthrough" review event[/url]



 Thank you.

notes.title: Announcement of the GMH "demo playthrough" review event!
notes.content:
Hello, this is Studio AWE.

 To celebrate GMH's participation in the Steam Game Festival: February 2021, I will be holding an event before the release of Gwan Moon High School : The Ghost Gate.

 [h3]Event Details[/h3]
[list]
[*] Play the latest version of the demo (1.21) and write a review. Then you just might be given a game key through a lottery!
[*] A total of 15 people will be drawn.
[list][*] 10 of which are randomly drawn
[*] 5 "Best Reviews" will be handpicked by Studio AWE: Should your review meet any or all the conditions below, then it has a greater likelihood of being selected as one of the "Best Review" by Studio AWE.[/list][/list][list][list][list]
[*] If it is written in Korean, English, or Japanese.
[*] If it is a playthrough video.
[*] If the review is detailed or shared through various channels (including social media).
[/list][/list][/list][list][*] The event period will start from 0:00 on February 4, 2021 and last until 0:00 on March 1, 2021. (KST) Any entries after the specified duration will not be entertained nor considered.
[*] The announcement of the 15 winners will be posted at 0:00 on March 8, 2021. (KST)[/list]
 [h3]How to apply?[/h3]
[olist]
[*] Please play the latest version (1.21) of the demo.
[*] Then, please write a review with your own personal opinion of the demo.
[list][*] There are no restrictions on how you are to do it. Playthrough videos, blog posts, short tweets and etc are all welcome. Remember, your review must reflect your own personal opinion of any feedback, criticism and etc that you may have from the demo![/list]
[*] Please fill out the application form for GMH's "demo playthrough" review event below.
[/olist][list]
[*] Korean : [url=https://forms.gle/9Z2BBDRrzYvbKWYZA]Korean application form[/url]
[*] English : [url=https://forms.gle/jKNBaNVSQQjH79cv9]English application form[/url]
[*] Japanese : [url=https://forms.gle/uwRD5SRfeYZwSTrt9]Japanese application form[/url]
[/list]
 [h3]To users who have already played the demo previously:[/h3]
[list]
[*] You can also apply with your past review of the demo. Thank you for your interest and love since early on!
[*] However, the latest version has extra content such as new features relating to the collectibles made available. Notwithstanding the event, I would very much appreciate it if you could replay the latest version of the GMH demo![/list]
 [h3]Additional announcements:[/h3]
Please don't forget to follow/subscribe to Studio AWE's social media account(s).
   - Twitter account : https://twitter.com/StudioAWE_EN
   - Facebook page : https://www.facebook.com/StudioAWE
   - YouTube Channel : https://www.youtube.com/channel/UC_NtmGPTwAmoDcIqTdznrJw

 Thank you always.

 As always, I convey my sincerest thanks.

notes.title: Release date is postponed
notes.content:
Hello, This is Studio AWE.

 Hope this finds you all well.

 First of all, I'm truly sorry about the setback in the release.

 When I opened the store page, I had planned for the release date to be the autumn of 2020, but I was forced to postpone the release date due to there being workload and other logistic delays than I had expected.

 Although specific release date is not set yet, it is expected to be possible by the upcoming winter or spring at the latest.

 Let me inform you about the current progress.

[list]
[*] Game making is complete. A little fine-tuning is in progress.
[*] English translation is steadily being handled. It's completion is about 75% done.
[*] Japanese translation has been delayed.
[*] Creation of Steam achievements and trading cards is underway.
[/list]

 Once again, I am truly sorry for this.
